requirements.description: Read the story of Jesus feeding the multitude in Matthew 14:15-21.
Read an article on the topic of world hunger. Discuss with your Pathfinder Club, unit or class methods that can be used to prevent hunger.

Ask a person who is involved in a community food bank or soup kitchen in your area about the types of people they serve, what causes food needs in the community, and how they meet those needs. Take notes.
Collect at least 10 non-perishable food items for a food bank, the nearest Adventist Community Services center, or the Adventist church for distribution to those in need.
Volunteer in a soup kitchen for at least one meal shift or in a food bank for 2 hours. This can be done as a group project with other members of your Pathfinder Club or school.
